title: apohara-seal-v1 receipt
description: Wire schema for a apohara-sealchain `.seal.json` receipt: an artifact payload plus a seal block carrying the canonical preimage and one entry per active layer (HMAC, Ed25519, C2PA, TSA, Rekor v2). Authoritative shape matches crates/apohara-sealchain-core/src/schema.rs and artifact.rs. See SPEC.md for layer semantics.

payload.description: Application payload. The artifact orchestrator (`seal_artifact`) emits the artifact descriptor below, but the seal engine accepts any JSON object as a payload; only `artifactSha256` is required by `verify_artifact`'s content layer.

artifactSha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the artifact file bytes (no 0x prefix).

path.description: Artifact file name (basename), as recorded at seal time.

mime.description: Guessed MIME type, or application/octet-stream when unknown.

seal.description: The seal block: method tag, timestamp, canonical preimage, and one entry per active layer.

not.description: c2paManifest (sidecar) and c2paEmbedded (in-file) are mutually exclusive.

method.description: Seal method tag. Always apohara-seal-v1 for this engine.

sealedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp the seal was produced at. Part of the preimage.

preimage.description: 0x-hex of the canonical preimage bytes: JCS({method, sealedAt, payload:strip_excluded(payload)}).

ed25519PublicKey.description: Embedded Ed25519 SPKI public key (PEM) making the receipt self-verifiable. Sibling of the layers, NOT part of the preimage.

c2paManifest.description: 0x-hex of the real C2PA JUMBF sidecar manifest store (SIDECAR mode). Sibling of the layers, NOT part of the preimage. Mutually exclusive with c2paEmbedded.

c2paEmbedded.description: True when the C2PA manifest is embedded IN the artifact file (in-file hard binding) rather than carried as a sidecar (EMBED mode). The C2PA layer is then verified by reading the manifest from the file itself. Sibling of the layers, NOT part of the preimage. Mutually exclusive with c2paManifest.

hmacLayer.description: Mandatory HMAC-SHA256 layer over the canonical preimage.

keyId.description: HMAC key identifier (hmac-default for the generated/default key).

sig.description: 0x-hex HMAC-SHA256 tag over the preimage (32 bytes / 64 hex chars).

ed25519Layer.description: Optional Ed25519 layer over the canonical preimage (raw 64-byte signature).

keyId.description: Ed25519 key identifier (default for the generated/default key).

sig.description: 0x-hex Ed25519 signature over the preimage (64 bytes / 128 hex chars).

tsaLayer.description: Optional RFC 3161 TSA layer. The timestamped imprint is sha256(hmac.sig || ed25519.sig). Sibling of the layers, NOT part of the preimage.

authority.description: Short authority label for the TSA (e.g. sigstore, freetsa, or the host).

issuedAt.description: Token issuance time from TstInfo.genTime, RFC 3339.

der.description: 0x-hex of the full DER-encoded RFC 3161 TimeStampResp token.

rekorAnchor.description: Optional Sigstore Rekor v2 DSSE transparency anchor over the canonical preimage. Sibling of the layers, NOT part of the preimage. Verified offline (RFC 6962 Merkle inclusion + C2SP checkpoint signature against a pinned shard key).

logId.description: Log ID (base64). Resolves the pinned shard public key for checkpoint verification.

integratedTime.description: Integrated time (Unix seconds) as reported by the log.

canonicalizedBody.description: Base64 of the canonicalized Rekor entry body (the Merkle leaf preimage).

inclusionProof.description: RFC 6962 inclusion proof plus the C2SP signed-note checkpoint.

treeSize.description: Tree size the proof is against.

rootHash.description: Root hash (hex), committed by the checkpoint.

hashes.description: Sibling hashes (hex) along the leaf-to-root path.

checkpoint.description: C2SP signed-note checkpoint text (origin, size, root, signatures).

dsseEnvelope.description: The DSSE envelope submitted to Rekor: an in-toto Statement payload signed by the seal's Ed25519 key.

payload.description: Base64 of the in-toto Statement JSON (subject digest sha256 = sha256(preimage)).

sig.description: Base64 of the Ed25519 signature over the DSSE PAE.

rekorVerifier.description: The self-managed verifier: the seal's Ed25519 public key (SPKI DER, base64) plus keyDetails.

rawBytes.description: Base64 SPKI DER of the seal's Ed25519 public key.
